claims.claim_text: Total revenue declined to $319.0 million in 2025 from $510.7 million in 2024; Adjusted EBITDA collapsed to $29.7 million in 2025 from $157.4 million in 2024; operating loss expanded to $245.6 million from $142.1 million; net loss $288.6 million.
claims.subject: Core Scientific
claims.source_quote: During 2025, total revenue decreased to $319.0 million from $510.7 million, primarily due to lower digital asset self-mining revenue and digital asset hosted mining revenue as we shifted capital and infrastructure toward colocation, partially offset by higher colocation revenue from incremental billable customer power capacity. Operating loss increased to $245.6 million in 2025 from $142.1 million in 2024. Net loss was $288.6 million in 2025... Adjusted EBITDA decreased to $29.7 million in 2025 from $157.4 million in 2024.

claims.claim_text: Company identified a material weakness in internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2025 related to accounting for demolished property/equipment during HDC conversion; concurrently filing a restated 10-K/A for FY2024 and 10-Q/As for Q1/Q2/Q3 2025. KPMG issued an adverse opinion on ICFR.
claims.subject: Core Scientific
claims.object_value: Adverse ICFR opinion + restatement of FY2024 + three 2025 quarterly 10-Q/As
claims.source_quote: our internal control over financial reporting was not effective due to the material weakness described below. ... We did not effectively operate controls to account for intended demolition of building and infrastructure assets ... This material weakness resulted in material misstatements to property, plant and equipment ... and resulted in the restatement of previously issued annual and interim financial statements. ... Our independent registered public accounting firm, KPMG LLP ... issued an adverse opinion on the effectiveness of the Company's internal control over financial reporting.

claims.claim_text: Proposed CoreWeave all-stock acquisition of Core Scientific (announced July 7, 2025) was terminated October 30, 2025 following CORZ stockholder rejection at special meeting; Company incurred $21.6 million in advisory fees.
claims.subject: Core Scientific
claims.object_value: CoreWeave all-stock acquisition rejected by CORZ shareholders 10/30/2025
claims.source_quote: On July 7, 2025, the Company entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger ... with CoreWeave ... pursuant to which CoreWeave would acquire the Company in an all-stock transaction... On October 30, 2025, the Company terminated the Merger Agreement in accordance with its terms following Company stockholder rejection of the terms of the Merger Agreement at a special meeting of stockholders on that date. The Company incurred $21.6 million of advisory, legal, and other professional or consulting fees related to the proposed transaction
